book.name: MATEO
book.title: QꞌU BꞌAꞌNLA CHAJ CHUSBꞌALTETZ U JESUUS ITZꞌIBꞌA U TIO Unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla yol uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan taꞌn u Mateo tiꞌ u Jesús

content: Ni tal u Jesús umaꞌl u kꞌuchuvatz tiꞌ umaꞌl u naj uvaꞌ bꞌex avoj
An chit tu u qꞌiieꞌ, el veꞌt chꞌuꞌl u Jesús tu kabꞌal. As bꞌex veꞌt Aak xonloj tziꞌ u mar.
As aꞌ chit mamaꞌla tenameꞌ imol tibꞌ tiꞌ Aak. As ok veꞌt Aak tu umaꞌl u barco. Xonebꞌ veꞌt Aak. As kaaik veꞌt kan unqꞌa tenameꞌ tziꞌ u aꞌeꞌ.
Nimal unqꞌa yoleꞌ nikat tal Aak te unqꞌa tenameꞌ. As tukꞌ kꞌuchuvatz nikat ichusunkat Aak. Ech tal Aak ileꞌ: —Bꞌex veꞌt umaꞌl u naj avoj.
As tul av naj, as at unqꞌa iiaeꞌ uvaꞌ echik toon tu bꞌey. As ul unqꞌa tzꞌikineꞌ. As ijuna veꞌt txoo.
As at unqꞌa iiaeꞌ ech toon xoꞌl unqꞌa kꞌubꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌlkat tuul txꞌavaꞌ. As oora chit kat bꞌuuqꞌi, tan yeꞌl tuul txꞌavaꞌ at xoꞌl unqꞌa kꞌubꞌeꞌ.
As tul kat tzꞌeꞌsan veꞌt u qꞌiieꞌ, as oora kuxh kat tzaj veꞌteꞌ, tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌl taqꞌil kat bꞌen taꞌn unqꞌa kꞌubꞌeꞌ.
As at unqꞌa iiaeꞌ echik toon xoꞌl chꞌiꞌx. As tul kat chꞌii unqꞌa chꞌiꞌxeꞌ, as kat isoka veꞌt unqꞌa chꞌiꞌxeꞌ u chikoeꞌ.

Pet ech koj unqꞌa iiaeꞌ uvaꞌ echik toon tu u bꞌaꞌnla txꞌavaꞌeꞌ, tan kat taqꞌ ivatz. As ati uvaꞌ kat aqꞌon oꞌkꞌalal (100) ivatz tiꞌ junun viꞌl; as ati uvaꞌ kat aqꞌon oxkꞌalal (60) ivatz; as ati uvaꞌ kat aqꞌon vinaj laval (30) ivatz.
As abꞌiste ex uvaꞌ nepal tu vunyoleꞌ, as etabꞌitaj uveꞌ ni valeꞌ,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
Nichꞌoti unqꞌa chusulibꞌ isuuchil u kꞌuchuvatzeꞌ
As ijetzꞌ veꞌt ok tibꞌ unqꞌa ichusulibꞌ u Jesús skꞌatz. As ech tal veꞌt chajnaj ileꞌ te Aak: —¿Kam bꞌan taꞌneꞌ, Pap, uvaꞌ tukꞌ kuxh kꞌuchuvatz nachusunkat te unqꞌa tenameꞌ?— tiꞌk chajnaj.

Ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —As ex uvaꞌ at veꞌt ok ex xoꞌl unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ at jaqꞌ u tijleꞌm u Tiixheꞌ. As sete tuk valkat isuuchil u tijleꞌm u Tiixheꞌ, as yeꞌxhibꞌil ootzin tetz. Pet ech koj unjoltu unqꞌa tenameꞌ, as yeꞌxhkam la alax isuuchil ste.

As abꞌil uvaꞌ ni toksa taama tiꞌ inimat u yoleꞌ, kꞌuxh bꞌiil kuxh nipal stuul, as la alpu isuuchil ste. As aal la chee itxumbꞌal stiꞌ. Pet ech koj u uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ ni toksa taama tiꞌ tabꞌit u yoleꞌ as tukꞌ tiꞌ inimataꞌ, as aal la sotzsal veꞌt u yoleꞌ skꞌuꞌl.
Estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ tukꞌ kꞌuchuvatz nunchusunkat xoꞌl unqꞌa tenameꞌ, tan kꞌuxh ni tileꞌ kam uveꞌ nunbꞌaneꞌ as kꞌuxh ni tabꞌi unqꞌa yoleꞌ uvaꞌ ni valeꞌ, as yeꞌ nipal stuul.
As aꞌeꞌ nibꞌaneꞌ uvaꞌ itzꞌibꞌa kan u Isaías, u qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ, uvaꞌ ech ni tal ileꞌ:

content.text: Kꞌuxh nimal yol la tabꞌi, as yeꞌ la pal stuul;
as kꞌuxh nimal unqꞌa veeꞌ la tileꞌ, as yeꞌ la texhla,
tan yannal itxumbꞌal unqꞌa tenameꞌ. As eela kuxh stukꞌ uvaꞌ jupel vixikineꞌ tukꞌ vivatzeꞌ.
As yeꞌ nipal tisuuchil u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ ni tabꞌi tukꞌ uvaꞌ ni tileꞌ.
As yeꞌ nijalpu vitxumbꞌaleꞌ. Estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌl ipaav la sotzi, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ itzꞌibꞌa kan u Isaías.

content: Pet ech koj ex, tan achvebꞌal chit ex, tan nepal stuul kam uvaꞌ netileꞌ. As nesaꞌ etabꞌit u yoleꞌ uveꞌ ni valeꞌ.

As jik chit ni val sete, tan yeꞌ saach unqꞌa qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ tukꞌ kaꞌt unqꞌa niman tetz Aakeꞌ uvaꞌ atik naꞌytzan kat saꞌon tilat unqꞌa veeꞌ netil cheel. As yeꞌ kat tila. As kꞌuxh kat isaꞌ tabꞌit unqꞌa yoleꞌ uveꞌ netabꞌi cheel, as yeꞌ kat tabꞌi.
Ni tal u Jesús isuuchil u kꞌuchuvatz
As etabꞌitaj isuuchil u kꞌuchuvatzeꞌ uveꞌ tuk valeꞌ tiꞌ u najeꞌ uveꞌ ni taveꞌ.

Tan unqꞌa iiaeꞌ uveꞌ kat kuꞌ tu bꞌey, as aꞌ ni tokkateꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ ni abꞌin u yoleꞌ tiꞌ u tijleꞌm u Tiixheꞌ. As yeꞌ nipal stuul, tan ni tul teesa u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ u yoleꞌ uveꞌ kat ok tu u taanxelal unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ.
As unqꞌa iiaeꞌ uveꞌ kat oon xoꞌl unqꞌa kꞌubꞌeꞌ, as aꞌ ni tokkateꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ tul ni tabꞌi u yoleꞌ, as nichiibꞌ stiꞌ. As ni tok u yoleꞌ tu u taanxelaleꞌ.

Pet ech unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ echeꞌ u iiaeꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ kat palik bꞌen u taqꞌileꞌ tu u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ, tan yeꞌ kat yakꞌin u yoleꞌ tu u taanxelaleꞌ. As yeꞌxh jatvaꞌl qꞌii kat ibꞌana, tan tul kat ul unqꞌa kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ tiꞌ u uxhchileꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ nimamal u yoleꞌ staꞌn, as oora kuxh kat kaꞌkabꞌin taama stiꞌ.

As unqꞌa iiaeꞌ uveꞌ kat oon xoꞌl unqꞌa chꞌiꞌxeꞌ, as aꞌ ni tokkateꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ kat abꞌin u yoleꞌ. As ni xaansa unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ taama tiꞌ unqꞌa veeꞌ at vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ as tukꞌ tiꞌ u txꞌiibꞌal qꞌiieꞌ uvaꞌ ni sotzsan ikꞌuꞌl unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ tiꞌ u yoleꞌ. Estiꞌeꞌ yeꞌ niyakꞌin u yoleꞌ tu u taanxelal unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ echeꞌ umaj u tzeꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ nivatzineꞌ.

Pet ech koj unqꞌa iiaeꞌ uveꞌ ech toon tu u bꞌaꞌnla txꞌavaꞌeꞌ, tan aꞌ ni tokkateꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ ni abꞌin u yoleꞌ as ninima. As niyakꞌin veꞌt u yoleꞌ tu u taanxelaleꞌ echeꞌ unqꞌa tzeꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ nivatzineꞌ, tan ati uvaꞌ ni taqꞌ oꞌkꞌalal (100) ivatz, as ati uvaꞌ ni taqꞌ oxkꞌalal (60) ivatz, as ati uvaꞌ ni taqꞌ vinaj laval (30) ivatz tiꞌ junun viꞌl,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
Umaꞌt u kꞌuchuvatz tiꞌ u vaꞌlexhla kꞌuach uvaꞌ echeꞌ trigo uvaꞌ at xoꞌl u trigo
As tal u Jesús umaꞌt u kꞌuchuvatz uvaꞌ ech ileꞌ: —Ech nibꞌan u tijleꞌm u Tiixheꞌ echeꞌ nibꞌan umaj naj uvaꞌ kat ichaj bꞌen ikꞌam tiꞌ tavat u bꞌaꞌnla iiaeꞌ uvaꞌ trigo tu vitxꞌavaꞌeꞌ.

As tul kat tzꞌotin veꞌteꞌ, as vat veꞌt unqꞌa kꞌameꞌ. As oon veꞌt umaꞌt u naj uvaꞌ nik ichꞌoꞌn taama tiꞌ vibꞌaal u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ. As bꞌex tava kan naj unqꞌa vaꞌlexhla iiaeꞌ xoꞌl unqꞌa trigo, uvaꞌ ech tiloneꞌ echeꞌ trigo.
Tul kat bꞌuuqꞌ veꞌt unqꞌa trigo, as xuꞌmat veꞌteꞌ. As antu veꞌt u vaꞌlexhla iiaeꞌ uvaꞌ echeꞌ trigo kat bꞌuuqꞌ xoꞌl unqꞌa trigo.

As oon veꞌt unqꞌa kꞌameꞌ xeꞌ vibꞌaal u trigo. As ech tal chajnaj ileꞌ: «Pap, bꞌaꞌnla iiaeꞌ unqꞌa iiaeꞌ uveꞌ kat bꞌex qava tu vatxꞌavaꞌeꞌ. ¿As katileꞌ qꞌi kat tzaakat veꞌt unqꞌa vaꞌlexhla chaj kꞌuacheꞌ uveꞌ echeꞌ trigo uveꞌ kat chee xoꞌl unqꞌa trigo?» tiꞌk chajnaj.

Ech tal veꞌt vibꞌaal u trigo ileꞌ te unqꞌa ikꞌameꞌ: «Aꞌ umaꞌl u uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ nichꞌoꞌn taama sviꞌ kat bꞌex bꞌanon,» tiꞌk vibꞌaal u trigo. As ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa kꞌam ileꞌ: «¿Pap, ma nasaꞌ uvaꞌ la bꞌen kutzuj u vaꞌlexhla kꞌuacheꞌ uveꞌ echeꞌ trigo uvaꞌ at xoꞌl unqꞌa trigo?» tiꞌk chajnaj.
Ech tal veꞌt vibꞌaal u trigo ileꞌ: «Yeꞌle, tan asoj la etzuj u vaꞌlexhla kꞌuacheꞌ uveꞌ echeꞌ trigo, as anteꞌ u trigoeꞌ la etzujeꞌ.

Pet chꞌiiojno skaabꞌil. As lanal ilej veꞌt u qꞌiieꞌ tiꞌ imakleꞌ, as aꞌn la val te unqꞌa makꞌol tetzeꞌ tiꞌ teesat chajnaj unqꞌa vaꞌlexhla kꞌuacheꞌ bꞌaxa. As la imol chajnaj. As la ikꞌal chajnaj tiꞌ tok tu xamal. As aꞌn la itzokꞌ veꞌt chajnaj unqꞌa trigoeꞌ tiꞌ ikolpeꞌ,» tiꞌk vibꞌaal u trigoeꞌ tal te unqꞌa ikꞌameꞌ,— tiꞌk u Jesúseꞌ.
Umaꞌt u kꞌuchuvatz tiꞌ u iiaeꞌ tetz u mostaza
As tal veꞌt u Jesús umaꞌt u kꞌuchuvatz. As ech tal Aak ileꞌ: —Ech nibꞌan u tijleꞌm u Tiixheꞌ echeꞌ uvaꞌ kat ibꞌan u iiaeꞌ tetz u mostaza uvaꞌ bꞌex tava umaꞌl u naj tu vitxꞌavaꞌeꞌ.

As kꞌuxh tzꞌup chit u iiaeꞌ tiꞌ unjoltu unqꞌa iiaeꞌ, as tul uvaꞌ kat chꞌii veꞌteꞌ, as nim chit kat oonkat tiꞌ unjoltu unqꞌa chikoeꞌ uveꞌ at tu u peꞌeꞌ. As ni tul veꞌt unqꞌa talaj tzꞌikineꞌ tiꞌ ibꞌanat visokeꞌ viꞌ viqꞌabꞌ u tzeꞌeꞌ,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
Umaꞌt u kꞌuchuvatz tiꞌ u levadura

As ech tal u Jesús ileꞌ tiꞌ umaꞌt u kꞌuchuvatz: —Ech nibꞌan u tijleꞌm u Tiixheꞌ echeꞌ nibꞌan u levadura uveꞌ nipaxi tibꞌ xoꞌl oxvaꞌl paabꞌal u harina. As kat ipaxi veꞌt bꞌen tibꞌ u levadura xoꞌl viqꞌotil u paaneꞌ. As kat isipkꞌisa veꞌt skajayil,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
Ni tal u Jesús unqꞌa kꞌuchuvatzeꞌ tiꞌ itzojpisal uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan
As jankꞌal chit unqꞌa chusbꞌaleꞌ uveꞌ nik tal Aak tiꞌ tilat u Tiixheꞌ isuuchil vitenameꞌ, as tukꞌ kuxh kꞌuchuvatz nik ichusunkat Aak. As yeꞌl umaꞌtoj yol nik tal Aak uvaꞌ jit tukꞌ kꞌuchuvatz,
tan aꞌeꞌ nik ibꞌan u Jesús kam uvaꞌ alel kan taꞌn umaꞌt u qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ, tul ech tal ileꞌ:

content.text: Tul la yolon in, as tukꞌ kꞌuchuvatz la yolonkat in.
As la val veꞌt isuuchil unqꞌa txumbꞌaleꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ ootzimal taꞌn unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ kꞌujbꞌaꞌl kan tul uvaꞌ sichee u vatz txꞌavaꞌeꞌ, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ.

content: Ni tal u Jesús isuuchil unqꞌa vaꞌlexhla chaj kꞌuacheꞌ uvaꞌ xoꞌl unqꞌa trigo

As taqꞌ veꞌt kan u Jesús unqꞌa tenameꞌ. As ok veꞌt Aak tu u kabꞌaleꞌ. Jetzꞌen veꞌt ok unqꞌa ichusulibꞌ Aakeꞌ skꞌatz. As ech tal veꞌt chajnaj ileꞌ: —Pap, bꞌan bꞌaꞌnil. Al isuuchil u yoleꞌ sqe uveꞌ kat aal tiꞌ unqꞌa vaꞌlexhla kꞌuacheꞌ uvaꞌ xoꞌl unqꞌa trigo,— tiꞌk chajnaj.
Ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —U najeꞌ uveꞌ ni avan u bꞌaꞌnla iiaeꞌ, as aꞌ VIKꞌAOL U NAJEꞌ.

As u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ, as aꞌeꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ. As unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla iiaeꞌ, as aꞌeꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ uveꞌ at jaqꞌ u tijleꞌm u Tiixheꞌ. Pet ech koj unqꞌa vaꞌlexhla kꞌuacheꞌ, tan aꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ echen kꞌatz u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ.

As u najeꞌ uvaꞌ nichꞌoꞌn taama uveꞌ kat avan kan u vaꞌlexhla kꞌuacheꞌ, as aꞌeꞌ u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ. Tul la maklu u trigo, as aꞌeꞌ vimotxtebꞌal u qꞌiieꞌ vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ. As unqꞌa makꞌol tetz u trigo as aꞌ unqꞌa ángel.

As echeꞌ uveꞌ nibꞌanchu te unqꞌa vaꞌlexhla kꞌuacheꞌ tan tul kat molaxi as kat oksal tu xamal tiꞌ itzꞌeꞌsaleꞌ, as echat tuk ibꞌan unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ ni bꞌanon u vaꞌlexheꞌ tul la ilej imoxtel u qꞌiieꞌ.

Tan la ichaj veꞌt tzan VIKꞌAOL U NAJEꞌ unqꞌa ángel tiꞌ ul teesat el unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ ni paavinsan vimooleꞌ as tukꞌ unqꞌa paasan tziieꞌ uvaꞌ ni bꞌanon u vaꞌlexheꞌ, uveꞌ at xoꞌl unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ at jaqꞌ u tijleꞌm u Tiixheꞌ.
As la sutil veꞌt bꞌen unqꞌa paasantziilla uxhchileꞌ tu u oornoeꞌ uveꞌ nitoypukat u xamaleꞌ. As tzitziꞌ la oqꞌkat veꞌteꞌ. As la ikꞌux veꞌt tibꞌ tee.

Pet ech koj unqꞌa jikla aamaeꞌ uvaꞌ at jaqꞌ u tijleꞌm u Kubꞌaaleꞌ, tan achaꞌv chit veꞌt tatineꞌ la ibꞌan vatz Aak echeꞌ nibꞌan u qꞌiieꞌ tul nitxijuneꞌ. As abꞌiste ex uvaꞌ nepal tu vunyoleꞌ, as etabꞌitaj uveꞌ ni valeꞌ.
Umaꞌl u txꞌiibꞌal qꞌii uvaꞌ mujel

As ech nibꞌan u tijleꞌm u Tiixheꞌ echeꞌ umaj u txꞌiibꞌal qꞌii uvaꞌ mujel tu umaj u txꞌavaꞌ. Tul la ilej umaj u naj u txꞌiibꞌal qꞌiieꞌ, as la chiibꞌ veꞌt naj stiꞌ. As la imuj kan naj. As la bꞌen ikꞌayi veꞌt kan naj unqꞌa tetzeꞌ skajayil, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la bꞌen iloqꞌ naj u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ uveꞌ atkat u txꞌiibꞌal qꞌiieꞌ.
Umaꞌl u bꞌaꞌnla kueentaxh uvaꞌ jeꞌnal ijaꞌmil
As ech la ibꞌan unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ nisaꞌ tok xoꞌl u tenameꞌ uvaꞌ at jaqꞌ u tijleꞌm u Tiixheꞌ echeꞌ la ibꞌan umaj aakꞌaꞌy uveꞌ nixaaneꞌ tiꞌ ichukat unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla chaj kueentaxheꞌ.
As tul la ilej naj umaj u bꞌaꞌnla kueentaxh uvaꞌ jeꞌnal ijaꞌmil, as la bꞌen ikꞌayi kan naj unqꞌa tetzeꞌ skajayil. As la iloqꞌ veꞌt naj u bꞌaꞌnla kueentaxheꞌ.
U kꞌach uvaꞌ tetz txeybꞌal txay
As ech nibꞌan u tijleꞌm u Tiixheꞌ echeꞌ nibꞌan umaj u kꞌach tetz txeyol txay. As tul uvaꞌ nisutil bꞌen u kꞌacheꞌ xeꞌ u aꞌeꞌ, as kam kuxh txayil ni tok tu u kꞌacheꞌ.

As tul ninoo veꞌt u kꞌacheꞌ, as ni teqꞌol veꞌt el tzan tziꞌ u aꞌeꞌ taꞌn unqꞌa txeyol txayeꞌ. As nixonebꞌ veꞌt chajnaj tiꞌ itxaat veꞌt unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla txayeꞌ. As la ikol veꞌt chajnaj tu vixuꞌkeꞌ. Pet ech koj unqꞌa txayeꞌ uvaꞌ vaꞌlexh, tan la isuti veꞌt el chajnaj.
Echat chit la ibꞌaneꞌ tul la ilej vimoxtel u qꞌiieꞌ, tan la ul veꞌt unqꞌa ángel tiꞌ teesat el tzan Aak unqꞌa jikla aamaeꞌ xoꞌl unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ vaꞌlexh vitxumbꞌaleꞌ.
As la sutil bꞌen unqꞌa uxhchil uvaꞌ vaꞌlexh vitxumbꞌaleꞌ tu uveꞌ nitoypukat u xamaleꞌ. As tzitziꞌ la oqꞌkat veꞌteꞌ. As la ikꞌux veꞌt tibꞌ tee,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
As ichꞌoti veꞌt u Jesús te unqꞌa ichusulibꞌeꞌ: —¿Ma kat palyu ex tu unqꞌa yoleꞌ uvaꞌ kat val sete?— tiꞌk Aak. —Kano, Pap. Kat palyu oꞌ stuul,— tiꞌk chajnaj.

As ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —Tuk val sete, unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ chusel tibꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa tzaqꞌiteꞌ, as tul la pal tu u yoleꞌ tiꞌ tok unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ xoꞌl u tenameꞌ uvaꞌ at jaqꞌ u tijleꞌm u Tiixheꞌ, as ech la ibꞌaneꞌ echeꞌ nibꞌan umaj u bꞌaal kabꞌal uveꞌ kam kuxh kolel staꞌn tu vikabꞌaleꞌ. As la teqꞌo el tzan unqꞌa tetzeꞌ tiꞌ ibꞌanbꞌetaꞌ, as moj unqꞌa veeꞌ akꞌnale moj oꞌt veꞌteꞌ,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
Ni tixval u Jesús tu u Nazaret
As tul kat tzojpu veꞌt u Jesús tiꞌ talat unqꞌa kꞌuchuvatzeꞌ, as bꞌen veꞌt Aak.

As oon veꞌt Aak tu vitenameꞌ uveꞌ chꞌii kat Aak. As chusun veꞌt Aak tu u atinbꞌaleꞌ tetz nachbꞌal Tiixh. As teqꞌo veꞌt taama unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ taꞌn u yoleꞌ uveꞌ nikat tal Aak. As ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa uxhchil ileꞌ svatzaj: —¿Katileꞌ qꞌi kat bꞌex teqꞌokat u najeꞌ vitxumbꞌaleꞌ? ¿As katileꞌ qꞌi bꞌex ichuskat tibꞌ naj tiꞌ ibꞌanax unqꞌa nimla bꞌaꞌnileꞌ uveꞌ nibꞌan naj?
¿As jit kol vikꞌaol u seeoleꞌ qꞌa u najeꞌ? Tan itxutx najeꞌ u Maꞌleꞌ. As titzꞌin najeꞌ u Jacobo, tukꞌ u Xhuꞌl, tukꞌ u Simón, tukꞌ u Judas.
As ootzimaleꞌ unqꞌa tanabꞌ najeꞌ sqaꞌn. ¿Katileꞌ qꞌi tzaakat unqꞌa txumbꞌaleꞌ taꞌn naj?— tiꞌk unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ tal tiꞌ u Jesús.

As yeꞌ kat isaꞌ veꞌt unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ inimat u Jesús. As ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —Katil kuxh la oksalkat iqꞌii umaꞌl u qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ. Pet ech koj tu vitenameꞌ tukꞌ tu vikabꞌaleꞌ, as echeꞌ la koj oksal iqꞌii,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
As kaꞌl kuxh unqꞌa nimla bꞌaꞌnileꞌ ibꞌan veꞌt Aak xoꞌl unqꞌa tenameꞌ tzitziꞌ, tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ nikat ikꞌujbꞌaꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ ikꞌuꞌl tiꞌ Aak.
